title: Al'adu
description: Ten short stories about experiencing culture in Hausaland: a wedding in Kano, a camel race at a festival in Niger, a school trip to the old wall of Kano, a grandmother's baobab-leaf soup in Sokoto, a letter from the pilgrimage to Makka, a folk tale about an orphan and a magic stone, an essay competition on the Hausa language in Zaria, an old soldier's Burma memories on Remembrance Day in Kaduna, the Argungu fishing festival and an exchange student from the zango of Accra.

lessons.title: Ɗaurin auren Rufaida
lessons.summary: In Kano, Juwairiyya helps her best friend Rufaida on her wedding days: she spreads mats, sets the chairs in a row and welcomes the guests; the marriage is tied at the mosque, the guests eat until they are full, and the two friends promise that their friendship will last.
lessons.text:
Rufaida 'yar Kano ce, kuma ranar ɗaurin aurenta ta kusa. Ƙawarta Juwairiyya ta zo gidansu kwana biyu kafin ranar domin ta taimaka mata. Juwairiyya ita ce babbar ƙawarta tun suna yara a makarantar firamare.

Kwana ɗaya kafin ɗaurin auren, mata da 'yan mata suka taru a gidan Rufaida. Juwairiyya ta shimfiɗa manyan tabarmi a tsakar gida, sannan ta sa kujeru a jere a gefen bango. Duk wanda ya shigo, sai ta ce masa, "Maraba, maraba! Ku shigo, ku zauna." Ƙawayen Rufaida suka zauna a kan tabarmin, suna waƙa, suna dariya. Gidan ya cika da walwala.

Da yamma, wata mace ta saka wa Rufaida lalle a hannu da ƙafa. Rufaida ta ce wa ƙawarta, "Ina jin tsoro kaɗan." Juwairiyya ta ce mata, "Kada ki damu. Gobe za a ƙulla aurenki, kuma za ki yi farin ciki."

Da safe, maza suka taru a masallacin unguwarsu, domin a can ne ake ɗaurin aure, ba a gida ba. Babban malamin masallacin ya yi ɗaurin auren a gaban mahaifin Rufaida da iyayen mijinta da sauran jama'a. Bayan an ƙulla auren, mutane suka yi addu'a, suka ce, "Allah ya ba su zaman lafiya."

Sai wani yaro ya gudu zuwa gidan Rufaida, ya ce, "An yi ɗaurin aure!" Mata suka yi ihu na murna, kuma walwala ta ƙaru a gidan.

Bayan ɗaurin auren, baƙi da yawa suka taru a gidan. Juwairiyya da sauran ƙawayen Rufaida suka shimfiɗa wasu tabarmi a waje. Suka ajiye kwanonin abinci a jere: shinkafa da miya, nama da kaza, da kuma lemu. Juwairiyya tana yi wa kowa maraba, tana kai musu ruwa da abinci. Baƙi suka ci suka ƙoshi. Wani dattijo ya ce, "Na ƙoshi sosai. Allah ya saka muku da alheri."

Da dare, aka kai Rufaida gidan mijinta. Kafin ta tafi, ta ce wa Juwairiyya, "Ke ce ƙawa ta gaskiya a gare ni. Na gode da duk abin da kika yi mini." Juwairiyya ta ce, "Mun ƙulla zumunci tun muna yara, kuma ba zai ƙare ba."

Tambayoyi:
Wace ce Juwairiyya?
Juwairiyya ita ce babbar ƙawar Rufaida tun suna yara.
Me Juwairiyya ta yi a tsakar gida?
Ta shimfiɗa tabarmi, kuma ta sa kujeru a jere a gefen bango.
Me Juwairiyya take ce wa duk wanda ya shigo?
Tana ce masa, "Maraba, maraba! Ku shigo, ku zauna."
A ina aka yi ɗaurin auren?
An yi ɗaurin auren a masallacin unguwarsu, ba a gida ba.
Me baƙi suka yi bayan sun ci abinci?
Sun ƙoshi, kuma wani dattijo ya yi musu addu'a.
Me ya sa gidan ya cika da walwala?
Gidan ya cika da walwala saboda ƙawayen Rufaida suna waƙa da dariya.

lessons.title: Raƙumin Agali
lessons.summary: Near Agadez, the boy Agali wants to ride his father Hamadou's fat camel with a brass bell in the race at the Ingall festival; he runs it in the sand every day until it is lean, his father lets him ride, another rider falls, and Agali's camel beats all the others.
lessons.text:
Agali yaro ne ɗan shekara goma sha biyar. Yana zaune da mahaifinsa Hamadou a wani ƙauye kusa da Agadez, a ƙasar Nijar. Mahaifinsa yana da wani babban raƙumi fari. A wuyan raƙumin akwai ƙaramar ƙararrawa ta tagulla. Duk lokacin da raƙumin yake tafiya, sai ƙararrawar ta yi ƙara.

Kowace shekara, bayan damina, ana yin babban biki a garin Ingall. Makiyaya daga wurare da yawa suna zuwa da raƙumansu da shanunsu. Ana yin waƙa da rawa, kuma ana yin tseren raƙuma.

A wannan shekara, Agali ya ce wa mahaifinsa, "Baba, ina so in hau raƙuminmu a tseren." Hamadou ya ce, "Kai yaro ne har yanzu. Idan ka faɗo daga kan raƙumi, za ka ji ciwo." Agali bai yi fushi ba. Kowace safiya yakan tashi da wuri ya kula da raƙumin, ya ba shi ruwa, ya kai shi kiwo.

Amma raƙumin yana da kiba sosai, saboda ya ci ciyawa da yawa a lokacin damina. Hamadou ya ce, "Raƙumi mai kiba ba ya gudu sosai." Sai Agali ya fara yin gudu da shi kowace rana a cikin yashi. Bayan wata ɗaya, kibar raƙumin ta ragu, kuma ya fi sauri.

Da Hamadou ya ga haka, sai ya ce, "To, na ƙyale ka. Za ka hau shi a tseren. Amma ka riƙe shi da kyau, kada ka faɗo."

Ranar tseren, mutane da yawa suka tsaya a gefen filin. Raƙuma ashirin suka fara gudu tare. Ƙararrawar tagulla tana ƙara a wuyan raƙumin Agali. Wani matashi ya faɗo daga kan raƙuminsa, amma ya tashi lafiya. Agali bai faɗo ba. Ya riƙe raƙumin da ƙarfi, yana yi masa magana a hankali.

A ƙarshe, raƙumin Agali ya yi rinjaye a kan sauran raƙuma duka. Shi ne na farko! Mutane suka yi ihu na murna. Wani dattijo ya ba Agali kyautar wata farar riga da zobe na tagulla. Hamadou ya yi murmushi, ya ce, "Ban yi kuskure ba da na ƙyale ka. Rinjayenka ya faranta mini rai."

Tambayoyi:
Me yake wuyan raƙumin Hamadou?
Akwai ƙaramar ƙararrawa ta tagulla a wuyansa.
Me ya sa Hamadou bai so Agali ya hau raƙumin ba da farko?
Saboda yana tsoron Agali zai faɗo daga kan raƙumin ya ji ciwo.
Me ya sa raƙumin ba ya gudu sosai?
Saboda yana da kiba sosai.
Me Agali ya yi domin kibar raƙumin ta ragu?
Ya yi gudu da shi kowace rana a cikin yashi.
Wane raƙumi ne ya yi rinjaye a tseren?
Raƙumin Agali ne ya yi rinjaye a kan sauran raƙuma duka.
Me Hamadou ya ce bayan kibar raƙumin ta ragu?
Ya ce ya ƙyale Agali ya hau raƙumin a tseren.

lessons.title: Ganuwar Kano
lessons.summary: The history teacher Malam Haidar takes his class to the old wall of Kano; he shows them its ring shape on a map, explains how a city wall differs from the wall of a house, the student Ilham asks what destroyed parts of it, and an old man says his family descends from its builders.
lessons.text:
Malam Haidar malamin tarihi ne a wata makarantar sakandare a Kano. Wata rana ya kai ɗalibansa ziyara zuwa tsohuwar ganuwar birnin Kano. Kafin su tafi, ya nuna musu wata tsohuwar taswira a aji. A kan taswirar, ganuwar tana da siffar wani babban zobe da yake kewaye da birnin.

Wata ɗaliba mai suna Ilham ta tambaya, "Malam, a wace takamaiman shekara aka gina ganuwar?" Malam Haidar ya ce, "Ba mu san takamaiman shekarar ba. Amma masana tarihi sun ce an fara ginin ne tun kusan shekaru dubu da suka wuce. Daga baya, wasu sarakuna suka ƙara girmanta. Wani lokaci tarihi ba ya ba mu takamaiman amsa."

Da suka isa ganuwar, ɗalibai suka yi mamaki. Ganuwar tana da tsayi sosai. Malam Haidar ya ce, "Katanga tana kewaye da gida ɗaya, amma ganuwa tana kewaye da birni gaba ɗaya. Alal misali, katangar makarantarmu ba ta kai tsayin mutum biyu ba, amma wannan ganuwa ta fi katangarmu tsayi sau da yawa."

Ilham ta ga cewa a wasu wurare ganuwar ta faɗi. Ta tambaya, "Me ya halaka wannan sashe na ganuwar?" Malam ya ce, "Ruwan sama ne. An gina ganuwar da ƙasa, kuma idan ruwan sama ya yi yawa, sai wasu sassanta su halaka. Alal misali, a shekarar da ta wuce, ruwan sama mai yawa ya halaka wani sashe kusa da ƙofar birnin. Mutane ma sun halaka wasu wurare domin su gina gidaje."

Sai wani dattijo da yake zaune kusa da ƙofar birnin ya gaishe su. Ya ce, "Ni daga zuriyar mutanen da suka yi aiki a kan wannan ganuwa ne. Kakannina sun gina ta da hannunsu. Har yanzu zuriyarsu suna zaune a unguwar nan." Ya nuna musu wasu ƙananan ramuka a jikin ganuwar, ya ce, "Alal misali, waɗannan ramuka, an yi su ne domin masu tsaron birni su duba waje."

Kafin su koma makaranta, Malam Haidar ya ce wa ɗalibai, "Wannan ganuwa tana cikin tarihinmu. Idan ba mu kula da ita ba, za ta halaka gaba ɗaya." Ilham ta zana siffar ganuwar a littafinta. Ta ce, "Zan ajiye wannan zane, domin zuriyata su ga yadda ganuwar take."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Malam Haidar ya kai ɗalibansa?
Ya kai su tsohuwar ganuwar birnin Kano.
Wace siffa ganuwar take da ita a kan taswirar?
Tana da siffar wani babban zobe da yake kewaye da birnin.
Wane bambanci ne yake tsakanin katanga da ganuwa?
Katanga tana kewaye da gida ɗaya, amma ganuwa tana kewaye da birni gaba ɗaya.
Me ya halaka wasu sassan ganuwar?
Ruwan sama ne, kuma mutane ma sun halaka wasu wurare.
Wane ne dattijon da ya gaishe su?
Dattijon ya fito daga zuriyar mutanen da suka gina ganuwar.

lessons.title: Miyar kakar Yasmin
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, Yasmin asks her grandmother Tabawa to teach her baobab-leaf soup: the old woman names each ingredient, cooks on a wood fire, keeps the soup in a clay pot rather than plastic, roasts potatoes in the hot ash, and tells Yasmin to learn well before she thinks of selling it.
lessons.text:
Yasmin tana zaune a Sokoto tare da kakarta, Tabawa. Kakarta ta shahara a unguwarsu saboda miyar kuka da take dafawa. Duk wanda ya ci miyarta, sai ya yaba da ɗanɗanonta.

Wata rana Yasmin ta ce, "Kaka, ina so ki koya mini yadda ake miyar kuka." Kakarta ta yi murmushi, ta ce, "To, zo mu fara da sinadarai."

Ta nuna mata sinadari na farko: garin kuka, wato ganyen kuka da ya bushe, aka niƙa shi. Sai ta nuna mata sauran sinadarai: albasa, gishiri, mai da nama. Ta ce, "Kowane sinadari yana da muhimmanci. Idan sinadari ɗaya ya rasa, ɗanɗanon miyar zai canza."

Kakar ba ta yin girki a kan gas. Tana amfani da wutar itace a bayan gida. Yasmin ta zauna kusa da wutar, tana jin ɗumin wutar a fuskarta. Lokacin sanyi ne, saboda haka ɗumin yana yi mata daɗi.

Da miyar ta kusa yi, kakar ta fara tuwo. Ta juya tuwon har ya yi laushi. Ta ce, "Tuwo mai kyau dole ya yi laushi, amma kada ya yi ruwa ruwa." Yasmin ta taɓa tuwon, ta ji laushinsa.

Bayan sun gama, kakar ta zuba miyar a cikin wata tukunyar ƙasa. Yasmin ta ce, "Kaka, me ya sa ba ki amfani da kwanon roba?" Kakar ta ce, "Gara tukunyar ƙasa da roba. Roba ba ta riƙe ɗumin miya, kuma wani lokaci tana canza ɗanɗanon abinci. Gara mu bi hanyar kakanninmu."

Sai kakar ta ɗauki wasu dankali, ta sa su cikin toka mai zafi a ƙarƙashin wutar. Bayan ɗan lokaci, ta fito da su daga cikin tokar. Suka goge tokar daga jikinsu, suka ci dankalin da ɗuminsa.

Yasmin ta ce, "Kaka, ina tunanin sayarwar miyar kuka a kasuwa. Mutane za su so ɗanɗanonta." Kakar ta yi dariya ta ce, "Sayarwa ba ta da wuya idan abinci yana da kyau. Amma da farko, ki koyi girkin da kyau." Yasmin ta ce, "Gaskiya ne, gara in koya sosai tukuna." Ta yi alƙawari cewa za ta koya sosai kafin ta fara sayarwa.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa kakar Yasmin ta shahara a unguwarsu?
Ta shahara saboda ɗanɗanon miyar kuka da take dafawa.
Wane sinadari ne na farko?
Sinadari na farko shi ne garin kuka.
Me Yasmin take ji a fuskarta kusa da wuta?
Tana jin ɗumin wutar a fuskarta.
Me ya sa kakar ba ta son kwanon roba?
Saboda roba ba ta riƙe ɗumin miya, kuma tana canza ɗanɗanon abinci.
A ina kakar ta sa dankalin?
Ta sa su cikin toka mai zafi a ƙarƙashin wutar.

lessons.title: Wasiƙa daga Makka
lessons.summary: A letter: Shatu writes from Makka to her grandson Abdurrahim in Kano about her first pilgrimage: she asked her neighbours to forgive her before leaving, was afraid on her first flight, was vaccinated against epidemics, endures the heat, keeps her money in a hidden pocket and has had enough food and water.
lessons.text:
Zuwa ga jikana Abdurrahim,

Ina fata kana lafiya, kai da iyayenka. Ni ma ina lafiya a Makka. Kamar yadda ka sani, wannan ne karo na farko da na zo aikin hajji. Na daɗe ina addu'a Allah ya kawo ni nan, kuma a wannan shekara ƙaddara ta kawo ni.

Kafin in bar Kano, na je gidajen 'yan'uwa da maƙwabta, na roƙe su su yafe mini duk abin da na yi musu. Wannan al'adarmu ce: mutum ba ya tafiya hajji sai ya nemi gafara. Kowa ya ce mini, "Mun yafe miki. Allah ya kai ki lafiya."

A filin jirgin sama, na ji fargaba sosai, domin ban taɓa hawan jirgi ba. Amma wata mata daga Katsina ta zauna kusa da ni, ta ce mini, "Kada ki ji fargaba. Ƙaddarar kowa tana hannun Allah." Daga nan sai fargabata ta ragu.

Kafin mu tafi, likitoci sun yi mana allura domin su kare mu daga annoba. Sun ce idan mutane miliyoyi suka taru a wuri ɗaya, annoba tana iya yaɗuwa da sauri. Saboda haka, ina wanke hannuna kullum.

A nan Makka akwai zafi sosai. Ba na jin daɗin zafin, amma ina jure shi. Wasu tsofaffi ba sa iya jure zafin, sai su zauna a ɗaki har rana ta faɗi. Ni kuwa na ce zan jure, domin ban zo nan don hutu ba.

Ina ajiye kuɗina a cikin wani ƙaramin aljihu a cikin rigata, saboda ana sata a wuraren da mutane suka yi yawa. Wata rana, wani mutum ya so ya saka hannunsa a aljihuna, amma ƙaddara ce ta sa na juya a lokacin, sai na kama hannunsa, ya gudu.

Kada ka damu da abincina. Muna samun isasshen abinci da isasshen ruwa a otal ɗinmu. Abin da kawai ban samu ba shi ne isasshen barci, saboda muna tashi da dare domin yin ibada.

In sha Allah, nan da makonni biyu za mu dawo. Ka gaida iyayenka. Ka ci gaba da karatunka, kuma kada ka manta da sallah.

Kakarka,
Shatu

Tambayoyi:
Daga ina Shatu ta rubuta wasiƙar?
Ta rubuta wasiƙar daga Makka, inda ta je aikin hajji.
Me Shatu ta yi kafin ta bar Kano?
Ta roƙi 'yan'uwa da maƙwabta su yafe mata.
Me ya sa ta ji fargaba a filin jirgin sama?
Saboda ba ta taɓa hawan jirgi ba.
Me ya sa likitoci suka yi musu allura?
Domin su kare su daga annoba.
A ina Shatu take ajiye kuɗinta?
Tana ajiye su a cikin wani ƙaramin aljihu a cikin rigarta.

lessons.title: Jatau ɗan maraya
lessons.summary: A folk tale: the orphan Jatau lives with a cruel aunt who insults him and dresses him in patched clothes; he picks up a magic stone by the river, his talkative cousin tells her mother, the aunt seizes the stone, insults it and loses everything, and the village head ends the injustice.
lessons.text:
Ga ta nan, ga ta nanku.

A wani ƙauye, akwai wani yaro maraya mai suna Jatau. Mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa sun rasu tun yana ƙarami. Saboda haka, yana zaune a gidan matar kawunsa.

Matar kawunsa tana yi masa zalunci. Tana ba shi aiki mai yawa, amma ba ta ba shi isasshen abinci. Kullum tana yi masa zagi, tana cewa, "Kai maraya ne, ba ka da amfani!" Amma Jatau bai taɓa mayar mata da zagi ba. Rigarsa tsohuwa ce, cike da faci. Duk lokacin da rigar ta yage, sai ya sa wani sabon faci a kanta. 'Yar matar kuwa tana da riguna masu kyau, ba su da faci ko ɗaya.

Abokin Jatau guda ɗaya shi ne wani ƙaramin tsako da ya samu a bayan gida. Yakan ba tsakon hatsi, yana yi masa magana kamar mutum.

Wata rana, Jatau ya je bakin kogi domin ya ɗebo ruwa. A can ya tsinci wani ƙaramin dutse mai haske. Da ya riƙe dutsen, sai dutsen ya ce, "Kai yaro ne mai kirki. Ka faɗi abin da kake so." Ashe dutsen yana da sihiri! Jatau ya ce, "Ina so in sami abinci, ni da tsakona." Nan take sai abinci ya bayyana a gabansa.

'Yar matar kawunsa tana da surutu sosai. Ba ta iya ajiye magana a zuciyarta. Ta ga abin da ya faru, sai ta gudu gida da surutunta, ta faɗa wa mahaifiyarta komai.

Matar ta karɓe dutsen daga hannun Jatau. Ta yi masa zagi, ta ce, "Ka ba ni zinare da kuɗi!" Amma dutsen ba ya aiki ga mai zalunci. Abincin da yake gidanta duka ya zama toka. Sai ta jefa dutsen cikin kogi.

Da dare, tsakon Jatau ya je bakin kogi, ya tsinci dutsen daga cikin ruwa, ya kawo wa Jatau. Washegari, sarkin ƙauye ya ji labarin zaluncin da ake yi wa ɗan maraya. Ya kira matar, ya ce, "Duk wanda ya yi wa maraya zalunci, sihirin dutsen ba zai yi masa amfani ba." Daga ranar, Jatau ya zauna a gidan sarki, kuma bai ƙara sa riga mai faci ba.

Ƙurunƙus kan ɓera.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Jatau yake zaune a gidan matar kawunsa?
Saboda shi maraya ne, iyayensa sun rasu tun yana ƙarami.
Yaya rigar Jatau take?
Rigarsa tsohuwa ce, cike da faci.
Me Jatau ya samu a bakin kogi?
Ya tsinci wani ƙaramin dutse mai sihiri.
Wa ya faɗa wa matar labarin dutsen?
'Yarta mai surutu ce ta faɗa mata.
Me ya faru da abincin matar?
Abincin da yake gidanta duka ya zama toka.

lessons.title: Maƙalar Ummukulsum
lessons.summary: In Zaria, the student Ummukulsum enters an essay competition on the Hausa language; she writes about how Hausa creates new words and about the philosophy in its proverbs, rewrites her first version with reliable sources, a short summary and a strong ending, wins, and is interviewed on the radio.
lessons.text:
Ummukulsum ɗaliba ce a wata makarantar sakandare a Zaria. Wata rana malamar Hausa ta shigo aji ta ce, "Akwai gasar rubuta maƙala a jihar Kaduna. Duk wanda yake so, ya rubuta maƙala a kan harshen Hausa a zamanin yau."

Ummukulsum ta ce za ta rubuta. Ta yi tunani sosai a kan abin da za ta faɗa. Ta ga cewa Hausa harshe ne mai rai, domin yana ƙirƙira sababbin kalmomi idan sababbin abubuwa suka zo. Alal misali, masu magana da Hausa sun ƙirƙira sunan "jirgin sama" da "wayar hannu". Ta ce a cikin maƙalarta, "Harshen da ba ya ƙirƙira zai mutu."

Bayan haka, ta rubuta game da karin magana. Ta ce akwai falsafa a cikin karin maganar Hausa. Alal misali, "Sannu sannu, bai hana zuwa ba" yana koya mana haƙuri. Wannan falsafa ce da kakanninmu suka bar mana.

Ta kai siga ta farko ta maƙalar ga malamarta. Malamar ta karanta, ta ce, "Maƙalarki tana da kyau, amma ina so ki yi amfani da ingantaccen littafi, ba labaran da ba ki tabbatar da su ba. Kuma ki fara da wani ɗan gajeren bayani, domin mai karatu ya san abin da yake cikin maƙalar a taƙaice. Sannan ki kula da ƙarewar maƙalar. Ƙarewa mai ƙarfi tana sa mai karatu ya tuna da maƙala."

Ummukulsum ta je ɗakin karatu, ta nemi ingantaccen littafi a kan tarihin Hausa. Ta sake rubuta maƙalar. A farkon sabuwar sigar, ta faɗi a taƙaice abin da za ta tattauna. A ƙarewarta, ta rubuta, "Hausa ba ta mutu ba, kuma ba za ta mutu ba, muddin muna amfani da ita." Wannan siga ta fi ta farko kyau.

Bayan wata biyu, aka sanar da sakamakon gasar. Maƙalar Ummukulsum ce ta zama ta farko a jihar duka! Wani ɗan jarida mai suna Rayyan ya gayyace ta zuwa gidan rediyo domin su yi zantawa. A cikin zantawar, ya tambaye ta, "Me ya sa kika zaɓi wannan batu?" Ta ce, "Saboda ina son Hausa, kuma ina so in nuna falsafar da take cikinta." Bayan zantawar, mutane da yawa suka kira rediyon suna yaba mata.

Tambayoyi:
A kan me Ummukulsum ta rubuta maƙalarta?
Ta rubuta maƙala a kan harshen Hausa a zamanin yau.
Me ya sa ta ce Hausa harshe ne mai rai?
Saboda yana ƙirƙira sababbin kalmomi idan sababbin abubuwa suka zo.
Wace falsafa take cikin "Sannu sannu, bai hana zuwa ba"?
Tana koya mana haƙuri.
Me malamarta ta ce ta yi da siga ta farko?
Ta ce ta yi amfani da ingantaccen littafi, ta faɗi a taƙaice abin da yake cikin maƙalar, kuma ta kula da ƙarewarta.
Wa ya yi zantawa da Ummukulsum a rediyo?
Wani ɗan jarida mai suna Rayyan ne.

lessons.title: Kakan da ya je Burma
lessons.summary: On Armed Forces Remembrance Day in Kaduna, the old soldier Danbala tells his grandson Salim, visiting from London, how a bomb wounded his shoulder in Burma and a friend carried him to safety; he gives Salim a box containing his medals, and the crowd calls him a hero as the soldiers pass.
lessons.text:
Danbala tsohon soja ne a Kaduna, kuma yanzu yana da shekara casa'in da tara. Kowace shekara, a ranar sha biyar ga watan Janairu, ana tunawa da sojojin da suka yi yaƙi domin ƙasa.

A wannan shekara, jikansa Salim, wanda yake zaune a Landan, ya turo masa saƙo a waya. Ya ce, "Kaka, zan zo Kaduna domin ranar tunawa da sojoji." Bayan mako guda, Salim ya iso. Ya kawo wa kakansa wani hoto da abokansa na Landan suka turo.

A daren ranar, Danbala ya fito da wani tsohon akwati. Akwatin yana ƙunshe da kayan sojansa, da wasu tsofaffin hotuna, da lambobin yabo guda uku. Ya ce wa Salim, "Wannan akwati yana ƙunshe da tarihin rayuwata."

Sai ya ba shi labari. Ya ce, "Lokacin ina matashi, a yaƙin duniya na biyu, Turawa sun kai mu ƙasar Burma. Wata rana, jiragen yaƙi suka zo suka jefa bam a sansaninmu. Mun ji ƙarar bam ɗin daga nesa. Abokan gaba kuma suna harba bindigogi daga cikin daji. Mu ma muka harba bindigoginmu. Sai wani bam ya faɗo kusa da ni. Wani ƙarfe ya shiga kafaɗata ta hagu. Ban iya tashi ba."

Salim ya tambaya, "Wa ya taimaka maka, Kaka?" Danbala ya ce, "Abokina ne, wani soja daga Sokoto. Ya ɗauke ni a kan kafaɗarsa, ya yi tafiya da ni har zuwa asibiti, duk da cewa ana harba bindigogi. Shi ne gwarzo na gaskiya, ba ni ba."

Ya ƙara da cewa, "Bayan shekara guda, aka yi sulhu, yaƙin ya ƙare. Mun yi murna da sulhun, domin yaƙi ba shi da kyau. Har yanzu, idan ana sanyi, kafaɗata tana yi mini ciwo."

Washegari, Danbala ya saka kayan sojansa, Salim ya kai shi wurin bikin. Sojoji matasa suna wucewa a gaban gwamna da manyan baƙi. Lokacin wucewarsu, suka girmama tsofaffin sojoji. Wani soja ya ce wa Salim, "Kakanka gwarzo ne." Danbala ya yi murmushi. Da suka dawo gida, ya ba Salim akwatin da lambobin yabonsa, ya ce, "Ka ajiye shi. Kada ka manta da tarihinmu."

Tambayoyi:
Me Salim ya turo wa kakansa daga Landan?
Ya turo masa saƙo a waya cewa zai zo Kaduna.
Me tsohon akwatin yake ƙunshe da shi?
Yana ƙunshe da kayan sojan Danbala, da tsofaffin hotuna, da lambobin yabo guda uku.
Me ya faru da kafaɗar Danbala a Burma?
Wani ƙarfe daga bam ya shiga kafaɗarsa ta hagu.
Wane ne gwarzo na gaskiya a cewar Danbala?
Abokinsa daga Sokoto wanda ya ɗauke shi a kan kafaɗarsa.
Me sojoji matasa suke yi a ranar bikin?
Suna wucewa a gaban gwamna da manyan baƙi.
Me ya faru bayan shekara guda da ya ji rauni?
An yi sulhu, kuma yaƙin ya ƙare.

lessons.title: Kifin Labbo
lessons.summary: Labbo, a fisherman of Argungu and a member of its fishermen's association, complains with the others to the culture commissioner that men from another zone fish the river before the festival; the commissioner stops them, opens the festival officially, and Labbo's diligence wins him the biggest fish.
lessons.text:
Labbo masunci ne a garin Argungu, a jihar Kebbi. Shi mamba ne na ƙungiyar masunta ta garin. Kowace shekara ana yin babban bikin kamun kifi a kogin Argungu, kuma mutane suna zuwa daga ko'ina domin su kalla.

Labbo yana da wata tsohuwar raga da ya gada daga wurin mahaifinsa. Kafin bikin, ya gyara ragar, ya ɗaure wuraren da suka yage. Ya ce, "Da wannan raga zan kama kifi mafi girma a bana."

Amma makonni biyu kafin bikin, Labbo ya ga wasu mutane daga wata shiyya suna kamun kifi a kogin da dare. Doka ta hana kowa kamun kifi a kogin kafin ranar bikin. Labbo ya kira sauran mambobin ƙungiyar, suka yanke shawarar su kai koke. Suka rubuta koken, suka kai shi ofishin kwamishinan al'adu na jihar.

Kwamishinan, Alhaji Abdulganiyu, ya karanta koken, sannan ya gayyaci shugabannin ƙungiyar. Ya ce, "Na ji kokenku. Zan tura masu tsaro zuwa kogin. Kuma zan yi magana da shugabannin wannan shiyya." Bayan haka, ba a ƙara ganin mutanen ba.

A ranar bikin, mutane dubbai suka taru a bakin kogi. Kwamishinan ya tashi, ya buɗe bikin a hukumance. Ya ce, "A hukumance, na buɗe bikin kamun kifi na wannan shekara." Sai aka harba bindiga, masunta suka shiga ruwa da ragarsu.

Labbo ya yi aiki da ƙwazo. Ya yi ta jefa ragarsa, yana ja, yana sake jefawa. Sauran masunta suka gaji, amma shi bai daina ba. Himmarsa ta ba shi ƙarfi. Bayan awa ɗaya, ya ji wani abu mai nauyi a cikin ragarsa. Kifi ne babba, mai nauyin kilo saba'in!

Kwamishinan ya ba Labbo kyautar mota. Ya ce wa jama'a, "Wannan mutum ya nuna ƙwazo da himma. Kuma shi ne ya kai koke domin a kare kogin." Labbo ya ce, "Ƙungiyarmu ce ta yi nasara. Ni mamba ne kawai, amma himmar kowa ce ta kawo wannan."

Tambayoyi:
Wane ne Labbo?
Labbo masunci ne a Argungu, kuma mamba ne na ƙungiyar masunta.
Me Labbo ya yi da tsohuwar ragarsa kafin bikin?
Ya gyara ragar, ya ɗaure wuraren da suka yage.
Me ya sa masunta suka kai koke?
Saboda wasu mutane daga wata shiyya suna kamun kifi a kogin kafin bikin.
Wa ya buɗe bikin a hukumance?
Kwamishinan al'adu, Alhaji Abdulganiyu, ne ya buɗe shi.
Me ya sa Labbo ya kama kifi mafi girma?
Saboda ya yi aiki da ƙwazo da himma, bai daina ba.

lessons.title: Mariama daga Accra
lessons.summary: Mariama, a Hausa-speaking student from the zango quarter of Accra, comes to Kano on a student exchange; on her first day a labour union strike stops transport and her host Najwa's car is in for service, so they walk, rest in the shade, change her money and swap stories of each other's customs.
lessons.text:
Mariama ɗaliba ce a wata jami'a a Accra, babban birnin Ghana. Tana zaune a zango, unguwar da Hausawa suke zaune tun da daɗewa. A gidansu, ana magana da Hausa. A wannan shekara, ta sami gurbin shirin musayar ɗalibai tsakanin jami'arta da wata jami'a a Kano.

Da ta isa Kano, wata ɗaliba mai suna Najwa ta karɓe ta a gidansu. Washegari, suna so su je jami'a, amma babu motoci a hanya. Ƙungiyar ƙwadago ta fara yajin aiki, kuma ma'aikatan sufuri ma sun bi su. Babu motocin haya, babu babura. Sufuri ya tsaya cak a birnin.

Najwa tana da mota, amma motarta tana wurin gyara. Ta ce, "Na kai motata sabis jiya. Sai gobe za a gama sabis ɗin." Sai suka yanke shawarar tafiya a ƙafa.

A hanya, sun ji wani shugaban ƙungiyar ƙwadago yana magana a rediyon wani shago. Ya ce, "Ba mu yarda da tilastawa ba. Duk ma'aikacin da yake so ya yi aiki, ya yi. Amma muna so gwamnati ta ƙara albashi." Mariama ta ce, "A Ghana ma ana yin yajin aiki, kuma ƙungiyoyin ƙwadago suna cewa babu tilastawa."

Rana tana zafi sosai. Suka tsaya a ƙarƙashin inuwar wata babbar bishiya. A inuwar, sun sami wasu tsofaffi suna hira. Ɗaya daga cikinsu ya ji yadda Mariama take magana, ya ce, "Hausarki tana da daɗi, amma ba kamar ta Kano ba ce." Mariama ta yi dariya, ta ce, "Ni 'yar Accra ce. Kakannina sun tafi Ghana daga Katsina."

Bayan sun huta a inuwa, suka je wani wurin musayar kuɗi. Mariama ta yi musayar kuɗin Ghana da naira. Sannan suka zauna suna musayar labarai. Mariama ta faɗa wa Najwa yadda ake bikin Sallah a zangon Accra, Najwa kuma ta faɗa mata yadda ake hawan Sallah a Kano. Mariama ta ce, "Ashe musayar ɗalibai ba ta karatu kawai ba ce. Musayar al'adu ce kuma."

Tambayoyi:
Daga ina Mariama ta fito?
Ta fito daga zango a Accra, babban birnin Ghana.
Me ya sa babu motoci a hanya?
Saboda ƙungiyar ƙwadago ta fara yajin aiki, kuma ma'aikatan sufuri sun bi su.
A ina motar Najwa take?
Tana wurin gyara, domin an kai ta sabis.
Me shugaban ƙungiyar ƙwadago ya ce game da tilastawa?
Ya ce ba su yarda da tilastawa ba.
A ina suka huta?
Sun huta a ƙarƙashin inuwar wata babbar bishiya.
